response.rationale: All options map to the same leaf 'Cutaneous metastasis' with the same relation type and support scores. Therefore, the ranking is based on the prior option rank, which reflects the system's confidence in the specificity of each option given the vignette details. Option B (Carcinoma erysipeloides) is ranked second, as the vignette describes 'erythema'. Option D (Carcinoma en cuirasse) is ranked third, as there is no mention of sclerodermiform changes. Option A (Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma) is the most general and is ranked last.
